roles.name: Administrator
roles.desc: Full control: roles, users, settings and the whole complaint lifecycle.

roles.name: Office Head
roles.desc: Oversight of all complaints, verification and reports. No system administration.

roles.name: Maintenance Engineer
roles.desc: Reviews incoming complaints, assigns contractors and verifies finished work.

roles.name: User Department
roles.desc: Ward or department staff who lodge complaints and rate the work done.

roles.name: Contractor
roles.desc: External agency that updates progress on the jobs assigned to it.
